river_nest_doss_challenge.speaker: Doss
river_nest_doss_challenge._comment: CI-TRAINER-CENSUS, 2026-08-30. T3-ACTIVITIES, spec sec6's 'River Nest: aggressive Water/Air creatures block a fishing location'. No `flag:`/`give:` effect here on purpose -- `river_nest_clear.gd` owns the actual gather-and-hand-over check (item_gate.gd, the same contract cart_repair.gd uses for Broken Cart) and only opens the dialogue panel to report the result; this is what a player sees before they are carrying everything. Same one-character-is-the-giver shape Old Bram established: the first line is the flag `revealed_by` waits on.
lines: Don't bother casting past the bend. Been trying to get that pair to settle for a week and they've decided the whole nest is theirs now.
Driftwood stakes and good lashings would pen them back out of the shallows -- wood and fiber, if you've got some to spare. I'd genuinely like to see the spot open again.

river_nest_doss_defeated.speaker: Doss
lines: That'll hold them. First quiet water I've seen off that bend all week.
Cast wherever you like now. I mean it -- you earned the spot more than I did.
